title_as_printed: Experimental data for the solubility of O2 in aqueous electrolyte solutions at 760 mmHg
pressure_note: oxygen partial pressure 1 atm (text: 酸素分圧1気圧); table title 'at 760 mmHg'; Ostwald coefficient referred to 1 atm; electrolyte-solution saturated water vapour pressure taken from literature to obtain the gas partial pressure

value.what: Ostwald coefficient L = VG/VL, VG volume of absorbed gas at the measurement temperature and pressure, VL volume of absorbing liquid; corrected for liquid swelling on absorption (expansion coefficient 0.0014 from partial molar volume of O2 31 cm3/mol)

composition.other_species: salt set per block by group_rows from the label row; Cs in mol/l of electrolyte solution. NaOH, Na2CO3, NaNO3, KCl, MgCl2, MgSO4, CaCl2, Ca(NO3)2, BaCl2, AlCl3, Al2(SO4)3 (NaNO3, Ca(NO3)2, BaCl2, AlCl3, Al2(SO4)3, NaOH, Na2CO3 and KCl are as printed; those outside the six-ion set are kept)

volume_basis_evidence: L = VG/VL with VL '吸収液体積' (absorbing liquid volume), liquid being the electrolyte solution; Cs in mol/l
conversion_needs: molarity (mol per litre of solution) to molality needs solution density
Temp is printed only on the first row of each temperature sub-block; filled down in the CSV
notes: Four printed column blocks (two upper, two lower per page layout) were stacked in reading order: left column (NaOH, KCl), second (Na2CO3, NaNO3, BaCl2), third (CaCl2, Ca(NO3)2, MgSO4 15 and 25 C), fourth (MgCl2, AlCl3, MgSO4 35 C, Al2(SO4)3). Blank spacer lines between temperature sub-blocks are not rows. For NaOH, concentration is the total sodium expressed as NaOH; 1-2% of the Na2CO3 present was ignored by the authors (text). Printed '0.008C0' in the scan (NaOH 25 C, 3.613) read as 0.00800.
